title: SARtale Lake Watch - story cut
note: Audio tags in [brackets] steer delivery and are not spoken (eleven_v4 has no SSML breaks; ellipses give pauses). Every fact is checked against video/story/codex_script.md (honesty table) and app/public/data/lakes.json.

shots.text: [Low, serious narration] A glacial lake above Hunza bursts... and takes the Karakoram Highway bridge with it.
[Measured, concerned] Pakistan tracks one hundred and thirty-one potentially dangerous lakes. But on many summer days, cloud hides them.
[Warmer, quiet confidence] NISAR's radar sees straight through.
SARtale finds each lake, measures its water pass after pass, and prints a one-page brief.
This summer: sixty valid looks, at eleven lakes.
[Hopeful, resolute] SARtale. When clouds close in... the lakes stay in view.
